description: Create a collection (many records of one shape) or a single (exactly one record, e.g. a homepage). For the initial setup of a site prefer propose_setup_plan so the owner approves everything at once. mode: 'editorial' (default — drafts, humans publish) or 'operational' (Live data — saves take effect immediately; the site reads AND writes it through the Application Data API with the server key, e.g. orders, counters, sign-ups). The mode is fixed at creation. A name the project already uses, in any case, is refused (COLLECTION_EXISTS): add fields to that collection instead.
name: create_collection
